messages.subject: GGPLOT not as expected
parts:
Hi all,

 

Last night I was plotting a four-paneled graph using this code:

 

ggplot(data = Snakes_CB_Site_Species_no.season, aes(x=Treatment, y=Stand.snakes, fill = Species)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black") +

  facet_wrap(~Location, nrow = 2) +  scale_y_continuous(name="Standardized Observations") + scale_x_discrete(name="Treatment") +

  scale_fill_grey() +

  guides(fill=guide_legend(reverse=TRUE), colour=guide_legend(reverse=TRUE)) +

  ggtitle("Snake Observations by Species") +

  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size=20),

        strip.background = element_rect(colour="black", fill="#CCCCFF"),

        plot.title = element_text(face="bold", size=30),

        axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold", size=20),

        axis.text.x  = element_text(face="bold", size=20),

        axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold", size=20),

        axis.text =element_text(face="bold", size=20),

        legend.text=element_text(face="bold.italic", size=25),

        legend.title=element_text(face = "bold", size=30))

 

The background had the grey gridlines, and the facet headers (strips) were blue with a black outline. This has been as expected. This morning I run the exact same code, and get a white background and no black outline around the facet headers. Any thoughts?

 

Thank you!

 

Kristina Wolf
